transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Morgan, the casting director. Let's get started on finalizing the casting for our two principal roles, Mara Vale and Jules Arden. We have three finalists under consideration: Priya Shah, Tomas Reed, and Lena Brooks. Before I can make the binding casting call, I'll need the casting associate to log the chemistry result and the talent coordinator to log the selected actors' availability hold. Once both checklist entries are recorded, I can complete the call and we can move forward with offers. Let's hear what everyone has to share.
